title: Software Engineer I
text: Early-career Engineer I; no numeric years minimum. Relevant degree and modern programming language required. India salary is stated separately from quarterly bonus and RSUs. 1–2-year suitability is an early-career inference; no numeric minimum is stated. Employee compensation and benefits advertised; employmentType structured field says OTHER. Confirm employment terms at screening.

title: Software Engineer — Business Systems & Integrations
text: At least two years of production Python development; APIs and AWS integrations. India/Sri Lanka posting advertises fixed monthly compensation of USD 2,000. Employment type and any guaranteed contract duration are unconfirmed. The Canadian salary is a different posting.

title: Frontend UI/UX Engineer
text: One year production React; technical degree OR at least two years development. Employer page states annual salary USD 30,000–45,000; fixed/variable breakdown not stated. Fixed-term contract. Duration not published; cannot pass the 12-month rule.

title: Software Engineer — AI Agents
text: Description requires two-plus professional development years despite one-year metadata. Employer posting advertises ₹25–40L and separately lists equity; fixed/variable split unstated. Python/AI agents; occasional in-person collaboration. Check that travel fits staying in Hyderabad.

title: Senior Software Engineer — Frontend
text: Description requires at least two years. React, Next.js and TypeScript. Employer posting advertises ₹30–50L, but guaranteed fixed base split is not explicit. Strong preference for tier-one college or YC-startup experience. Employer careers page links Workable. Do not count additional overtime compensation.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
text: Two-plus relevant years of ML/software engineering; production ML and LLM experience. Employer requisition explicitly states annual base of INR 4,408,400. Retained from prior evidence review. Specialist experience is required; confirm original freshness.

title: Software Engineer — EAA Integrations
text: Two-plus years in integrations; Workato recipes/connectors are a material requirement. Employer requisition explicitly states annual base of INR 3,584,400. Retained from prior evidence review. Check Workato fit and application limits.
